name: invisible_playwright_mcp
description: Self-hosted, open-source AI browser agent that browses, clicks, types and reads real web pages from plain-English instructions; runs locally on a patched Firefox engine and ships as an MCP server and a local web UI

name: Orbi
description: Self-hosted coding agent that takes a labelled GitHub Issue through implementation, a separate review session against the Issue's acceptance criteria, merge of the reviewed head, and a tagged release

name: PersonalJarvis
description: Cross-platform desktop assistant with chat and voice, background agents, browser and desktop computer use, plugins and MCP, memory, and scheduled routines, plus a workspace that runs CLI coding agents side by side in Git worktrees

name: EvoFlux
description: Local-first desktop workspace for AI agent teams that brings conversations, files, terminal, browser, Git, memory, plugins, and verification into one workspace

name: Raven
description: Open-source host agent that plans complex tasks as DAGs and orchestrates built-in research, coding, design, and on-call agents plus third-party agents such as Claude Code, Codex, OpenClaw, and Hermes Agent over ACP, CLI, or OpenAI-compatible APIs

name: SUNGLASSES
description: MIT licensed input firewall for AI agents that scans text and files locally for prompt injection, credential leaks and data exfiltration with 1,554 patterns across 118 categories; ships as a CLI, a Python API and an MCP server

name: Orca AI Incident Archive
description: Open database of publicly disclosed AI agent security incidents since January 2025 (prompt injection, exploited MCP servers, poisoned agent packages, agents deleting production data): one Markdown record per event with an attack-chain diagram, primary sources and a confirmed-victim flag, plus JSON/CSV exports

name: TeamSort
description: Free tool to vote on a shared list and rank items together
